summary: South kerb beside treed grounds, nearest homes 20 m or more away.

best_section.where: Hunter Street south kerb just east of the side-street junction, beside the treed block

drivers.seclusion: Dense trees and open lawn on the south side; houses 20 m or more away, across the road or beyond the trees.
drivers.access_and_room: Kerbside lane with two cars parked at the start; room for a van.
drivers.traffic: Through road near a junction, moderate traffic.
drivers.convention: Cars park here; weekday 7am-12 noon no-parking sign nearby.

flags: Steep: about 7% grade, up to 12% at the steepest
sun_shade: Tree canopy shades the section from the south; north side houses cast morning shade on the road.
cannot_judge: Whether the land behind is public
